sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Jeet Bahadur Singh,Ashok Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
Heard learned counsel for applicants, learned A.G.A. for State and perused the record.

This application has been filed to quash the proceeding and cognizance and summoning order dated 27.03.2023 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Aligarh in Case No. 2026/2023 (State Vs. Sulendra Kumar and others), under Section 498A, 377, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act,
against Sulendra Kumar (Husband) and under Section 498A, 354, 504, 506, I.P.C. against Ashok Kumra and Harish Kumar and under Section 498A, 504, 506 I.P.C. against Tejpal, Kanti Devi, Pinki Devi and Pinki Devi, Suman Devi and Arvind, Police Station Gandhi Park, District Aligarh and charge sheet dated 17.09.2022 arising out of first information report dated 05.07.2022 in Case Crime No. 431/2022, under Section 498A, 377, 354, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Gandhi Park, District Aligarh.

Learned counsel for applicants submits that dispute between the parties and this matter is referred Sulendra Kumar And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151238275/

sentences.text: for mediation, parties may get an opportunity to amicably settle their dispute.

He, therefore,
submits that in view of the facts and circumstances of present case, it will be in interest of parties that they are referred for mediation to the Mediation Centre, High Court, Allahabad.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 have no objection, if the matter is being referred to mediation centre High Court, Allahabad Accordingly, matter is referred to Mediation & Conciliation Centre of this Court.

Applicant is directed to deposit a sum of Rs.20,000/- by way of demand draft/pay order in the name of Registrar General A/c, Allahabad High Court Mediation &
Conciliation Centre within two weeks from today.
After deposit of aforesaid amount, Mediation Centre shall send a notice to opposite party no.2 calling upon his to appear for mediation.
Out of the amount deposited by applicant pursuant to this order, a sum of Rs.15,000/- shall be paid to opposite party no.2 on his appearance before Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
The Mediation Centre shall complete the mediation within 3 months and submit it's report on the next date fixed.
List this case after three months.

In case, applicant deposits aforesaid amount with Mediation & Conciliation Centre, High Court,
Allahabad as stated above, further proceedings of above noted case, shall remain stayed till the next date of listing.
However, in case of default, in depositing the amount under the period prescribed, office shall immediately list this application for orders before appropriate Court as fresh.

Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Imtiyaz  Sulendra Kumar And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151238275/
